spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, schema, digest_text) (rate(mysql_perf_schema_events_statements_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])))

spec.description: Requires mysqld_exporter run with --collect.perf_schema.eventsstatements. digest_text is normalized (placeholders instead of literal values).
spec.title: Top queries by total latency (perf_schema digest)

spec.description: Total time / calls, per digest — surfaces queries that are individually slow even at low volume.
spec.title: Top queries by avg latency per call

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, schema, digest_text) (rate(mysql_perf_schema_events_statements_rows_examined_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])))

spec.title: Queries examining the most rows (candidates for missing indexes)

spec.expr: clamp_max(count by (instance) (mysql_slave_status_master_server_id{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} or mysql_slave_status_source_server_id{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}), 1) OR on(instance) (mysql_up{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} * 0)

spec.description: Green = source (no slave_status rows). Blue = replica. Works across MariaDB (master_server_id) and MySQL 9 (source_server_id).
spec.title: Server role
Disk I/O (InnoDB reads / writes per sec)

spec.description: From mysql_global_status_bytes_sent/received (client protocol traffic, not host-level NIC counters).
spec.title: Network throughput (bytes sent / received)

spec.description: Rate of new connection attempts vs currently open — helps spot connection churn separate from steady-state count.
spec.title: Network connections (rate of new TCP conns)

spec.description: 1 = healthy on both engines: uses replica_io_running directly on MySQL 9, or last_io_errno == 0 on MariaDB (which doesn't expose a running gauge here).
spec.title: IO thread health

spec.description: 1 = healthy on both engines: replica_sql_running on MySQL 9, or last_sql_errno == 0 on MariaDB.
spec.title: SQL thread health

spec.description: mysql_slave_status_retried_transactions — not present in the MySQL 9 replica_status output; this panel will show no data for mysql-job instances.
spec.title: Retried transactions (MariaDB only)

spec.description: Combines master_log_pos (MariaDB) and source_log_pos (MySQL 9) pairs. Bytes received but not yet applied by the SQL/replica thread.
spec.title: Log position drift (read vs executed)

spec.description: Combines seconds_behind_master (MariaDB) and seconds_behind_source (MySQL 9) into one series. Thresholds: green < 2s, amber < 10s, red >= 10s.
spec.title: Replication lag (sec behind source)

spec.description: mysql_slave_status_relay_log_space — same metric name on both MariaDB and MySQL 9. max_relay_log_size wasn't seen in the MySQL 9 sample; that series may show no data there.
spec.title: Relay log space used
